name: Alberta Advantage Immigration Program (AAIP)
description: Skilled-worker streams of the Alberta Advantage Immigration Program (AAIP) and whether they run through Express Entry (an Express Entry-aligned nomination adds 600 CRS points).

attributes.legal_status: in force on the access date (provincial programme under a federal–provincial agreement)

skilled_worker_streams.summary: Temporary foreign workers already working in Alberta with a full-time Alberta job offer in an eligible occupation and a positive LMIA or accepted LMIA-exempt permit
By Notification of Interest only, to candidates in the federal pool; dedicated pathways for health care, technology and police occupations

attributes.express_entry_aligned: Yes — Alberta Express Entry Stream (by invitation from the federal pool)
attributes.notes: Worker streams require a Worker Expression of Interest first ($135 fee from 7 April 2026). 2026 priorities: health care, technology, construction, manufacturing, aviation, agriculture, Rural Renewal communities. Express Entry priority-sector draws held 20 October 2026.
attributes.status_dependency: Eligibility depends on occupation (NOC/TEER), job offer, language scores and existing ties to the province — all unknown (USER-PROFILE.md; OPEN-QUESTIONS.md items 2, 4, 7).

verification.notes: Read through search-engine extracts of the provincial programme's official pages, not fetched in full.

limitations: Stream rules change several times a year and intake is often by invitation only; read the provincial guide in force before applying.
